claims: Duke University is located in Durham, North Carolina.
Duke University is a private research university.
Duke University is known as the "Harvard of the South."
Duke University is situated within the Raleigh-Durham-Chapel Hill "Triangle" region.
Duke University's main campus spans nearly 9,000 acres.
Duke University's West Campus features Gothic architecture.
Duke University's East Campus is historic.
Durham, NC is part of the Research Triangle Park.
Duke University's campus is home to Cameron Indoor Stadium.
Cameron Indoor Stadium is for basketball.
Duke University's campus is home to the Duke Chapel.
Duke University operates a marine lab in Beaufort, NC.
Duke University operates international locations including Duke Kunshan University in China.
